name: SiulSC's Aircraft
description_html:
Currently in development

DISCLAIMER: All aircraft are static items - YOU CANNOT FLY THEM!!!

This was a fun project I wanted to make because I really like millitary aircraft and fighter jets. I won’t be updating this often but I will add some of the stuff that I think would be cool. Don’t ask about prices, they are intentional…

Recommended Mod to Install along with this: Hall of Fame Improvements by Utjan

mod folder -> user/mods directory
